name: I Ghost
source:
Hero is killed by someone and he is going through Hell and Heaven
to find salvation and reveal the truth about his death.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公遭人杀害。为了获得救赎并揭开死亡真相，他游历地狱与天堂。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
